QUOTE: The code message says a rebuild cannot fix it, and that only a client restart loads current code.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a data notice is fixed by refresh and a code notice only by a client restart. It also says a rebuild cannot clear schema or code staleness, and that the schema and code axes are never auto-refreshed. That separates the remedies by axis. It never says outright that this is why a single flag would not have been enough, but the mechanism is there.
